name: Render Means
definition: The simplest possible rendering where each Gaussian is represented by a single pixel at the location where its 3D mean projects onto the 2D image plane. It demonstrates the basic camera transformation pipeline (world → camera → image) and frustum culling without any rasterization complexity.
summary: Render Means projects 3D Gaussian means to single pixels, ignoring shape and spread to demonstrate basic camera transformations without rasterization complexity.
